Coronal mass ejection.fact: A coronal mass ejection (CME) is a significant ejection of plasma mass from the Sun's corona into the heliosphere. If a CME enters interplanetary space, it is sometimes called an interplanetary coronal mass ejection (ICME).

Evolved High Speed Packet Access.question: These speeds are made possible by combining MIMO (in _____ 7) with a more efficient modulation scheme, 64-QAM (in Release 8)
Evolved High Speed Packet Access.fact: These speeds are made possible by combining MIMO (in Release 7) with a more efficient modulation scheme, 64-QAM (in Release 8).
